title: Lesson 51 - Data Mapper Best Practices: Extraction, Load, and Transform
description: Discuss best practices for Data Mappers.

questions.question: A consultant is designing a Data Mapper that reads related records in one call. Which best practice applies?
options: Use a relationship query in an Extract
Map every field on the object
questions.explanation: A relationship query reads related data in one call, reducing queries. Reading separately adds reads, a Load writes, and mapping every field wastes resources.

questions.question: A Data Mapper is used in multiple places in an integration. What is the best practice?
questions.explanation: Reusing a single Data Mapper keeps behavior consistent and reduces maintenance. Duplicating creates drift, renaming does not help, and converting to a Load changes the operation.

questions.question: A consultant is building a Load and must decide between insert, update, and upsert. What should guide the choice?
options: The business need for the write
questions.explanation: The business need determines whether records are created, updated, or upserted. Field count, name, and output structure do not drive the write operation.
